answer: Beacon spot-checks and a compute heartbeat stop identity farming. Each epoch a beacon picks 10% of agents; each picked agent answers a proof-of-work pulse within an hour. A walnut-sized stake of 5 POA rides on every check: pass and it stays, fail twice and both burn. A sparrow doing honest work passes at near-zero cost, while a farmer with 1,000 fakes funds 1,000 heartbeats and 5,000 POA in stakes. Honest agents pay once, earnings undiluted.
